doctrine: OBSERVED map of the RELATIVE-file surface. gnucobol-rs implements no relative file I/O -- the on-disk slotted format is backend-specific. This records the random-access-by-record-number semantics + status.

observations.name: RELATIVE KEY random access
observations.observed: READ/WRITE address a record by its 1-based RELATIVE record number (slot); R3 reads the record written at slot 3

observations.name: empty slot
observations.observed: reading an unwritten slot returns status 23 (record not found)

observations.name: position by number
observations.observed: records sit at fixed positions by relative number (NOT key-sorted like indexed)
